content.text:
Done. The fix is one line.

## Change

**`fastify.js:603`** — added `preClose` to the special-case branch in `addHook`:

```js
} else if (name === 'onReady' || name === 'onListen' || name === 'onRoute' || name === 'preClose') {
  this[kHooks].add(name, fn)
```

Previously `preClose` fell through to the `else` branch, whose `_addHook` recursively copies the hook into every child via `this[kChildren].forEach`. Since `hookRunnerApplication('preClose')` already walks the child tree at close time, every propagated copy fired again. Storing it only on the declaring instance makes it fire exactly once, consistent with `buildHooks` in `lib/hooks.js:89`, which already resets `preClose` to `[]` for children.

**`test/close.test.js`** — two regression tests: one child plugin, and nested child plugins, each asserting the hook count is `1`.

## Verification

- With the one-line change reverted, the two new tests fail with `actual: 2` and `actual: 3` against `expected: 1` — matching the counts in the issue.
- With the fix, the full `test/close.test.js` file passes: 26 tests, 0 failures.

## Co-change partners

`fastify.js` is a hotspot (churn 45, fixes 12, fan_in 89) with six co-change partners. I checked each; **none needed a change**:

- `fastify.d.ts` — only re-exports `preCloseHookHandler` / `preCloseAsyncHookHandler`; types are unaffected by where the hook is stored.
- `docs/Reference/Server.md` — describes `preClose`'s position in the shutdown sequence, not its encapsulation/propagation, so it stays accurate.
- `lib/route.js`, `lib/warnings.js`, `build/build-validation.js`, `docs/Reference/Warnings.md` — no `preClose` references at all.

I also checked `docs/Reference/Hooks.md` (not a listed partner, but it documents the hook): it never claimed the hook runs per descendant instance, so the documented behavior now matches the implementation rather than contradicting it.

Two notes on the risk-map workflow: `COMPLEX.md` here is frontmatter-only — it has no "Why these files are hot" prose section and no "What to read first" list, so rule 1's "do what that paragraph's last sentence says" had no per-file instruction to act on beyond the co-change check in `.claude/rules/complex-md/fastify.js-1ps8zb.md`, which I followed above. I did not regenerate the map, since this is a one-line behavior fix rather than a refactor. Nothing is committed.
